Passion Fruit is a field crop unlocked at experience level 88.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for ??? coin.

Growing passion fruit

Passion fruit is grown in fields by planting another passion fruit plant (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 4 xp point, and takes 1 hour to mature.

Selling passion fruit

  • Passion fruit can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 180 coin for 10 units.

Using passion fruit

Passion fruit is used to make the following products:


Passion Fruit Juice Passion Fruit Pie Passion Fruit Jam
x2 x3 x3
Level 88 Level 92 Level 96
Tart Dressing Tropical Smoothie Fruit Sorbet
x2 x2 x1
Level 100 Level 104 Level 106
Tropical Yogurt
x1
Level 109

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for 16 to 26 passion fruit per crate, up to a total of 78 per boat.
